target.statement: Median ARI of PLSCAN at k=4 across all datasets is 0.66 (vs 0.57 for HDBSCAN* EOM).
target.dataset: All 17 datasets in Table 1 (smallest: Iris, 150 points)

compute.basis: Requires downloading 17 datasets (some large: MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, Audioset), applying UMAP/CLIP/MiniLM preprocessing, and running PLSCAN + HDBSCAN* at k=4; the code repo exists but preprocessing scripts and exact configs are not clearly linked, so some reimplementation is needed.

blockers: Preprocessing pipeline (UMAP, CLIP, MiniLM embeddings) not fully specified in code release
Audioset subset construction is manual and not provided
Exact random seeds for k-sampling not given
title: Persistent Multiscale Density-based Clustering
